set.body:
Defect: D5/D7 are only half-closed without this, and the plan's minimum subset over-claimed until a reviewer caught it. docs/data/sherlock/source-manifest.json has NO `artifacts` key at all -- its keys are mediaParts, boundNonVideoRecords, orderedMediaPair -- so a v2 parser requiring artifacts cannot read it. And the 1.0 handoff says of T8 that 'the data design is sound and should not change'.

Do: Lift the Sherlock manifest to thin v2 (artifact identity + RecordRefs + extensions; typed records stay in their own files, which is how docs/data/sherlock/ is ALREADY organized -- timebase-repair, alias-map, annotation-lineage). Then route sherlockRecallMap through Verified ON THE MAIN PATH, not just in tests. Prefer the thin lift over a rewrite.

Tests: A per-manifest migration line recorded for each of the four existing manifests.

Mutants (SD1 — each must die, recorded by name): bypass Verified in sherlockRecallMap -> a main-path test must fail.

Exit: D5 and D7 are actually closed for Sherlock rather than nominally.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S4 'Manifest migration'
set.title: intake P5: lift the Sherlock manifest to thin v2 and verify it on the MAIN path
